_help: Forecourt zones as [x, y] fractions of the frame (0..1). A vehicle is in a zone when the bottom-centre of its box is inside the polygon. 'videos' overrides the default for clips whose file name contains the key. bay_stationary_trigger_s: seconds a vehicle must stand still in Bay_01 before a refuel is recorded. stationary_px_frac: max movement in 1 s, as a fraction of the frame diagonal, to count as standing still.
